_comment: Mechanical exhaust of the example house: each fan's duct as a polyline of [x, y, z] points in metres (plan x east, z south, y up from the finished floor), from the fan collar to the outside face of the wall, and its outlet. Built in 3D by tools/house-model/build_house.py and counted and checked by apps/web/src/ventilation.ts against the Quebec Construction Code, Chapter I Building (NBC 2020 with Quebec amendments): the fan's airflow and sound rating, the duct's length for its size and the fan's static pressure (Table 9.32.3.11.-A), insulation through unheated space, discharge to the outdoors and the outlet's damper and height. The bathroom duct crosses the unheated attic above the ceiling to a wall cap in the east gable wall, so no soffit is near the outlet; the house has no outdoor air intake.
